title: Products and powers of quasi-coherent ideal sheaves; square-zero and nilpotent ideal sheaves
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $\mathcal I,\mathcal J\subseteq\mathcal O_X$ quasi-coherent sheaves of ideals [pqf-def-coherent]. Their *product* $\mathcal I\mathcal J$ is the quasi-coherent sheaf of ideals with $(\mathcal I\mathcal J)|_U=(\mathcal I(U)\mathcal J(U))^\sim$ on every affine open $U=\operatorname{Spec}R$ of $X$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum], where $\mathcal I(U)\mathcal J(U)\subseteq R$ is the product of ideals (these glue, since forming the product of ideals commutes with localization $R\to R_f$); equivalently, the image of $\mathcal I\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}\mathcal J\to\mathcal O_X$. The powers are $\mathcal I^0=\mathcal O_X$ and $\mathcal I^{n+1}=\mathcal I^n\mathcal I$, so $\mathcal I^n(U)=\mathcal I(U)^n$ on affine opens $U$. The ideal sheaf $\mathcal I$ *has square zero* if $\mathcal I^2=0$, and is *nilpotent* if $\mathcal I^{n+1}=0$ for some integer $n\ge0$; equivalently, $\mathcal I(U)^2=0$, resp. $\mathcal I(U)^{n+1}=0$, in $\mathcal O_X(U)$ for every affine open $U$.
